_comment: MANUAL, NOT SCRAPED. The execution plan says "manual LeetCode contest
calendar entry v0, no scraping", and scraping leetcode.com would be both
fragile and a terms problem. So the calendar is data in this repository and
the sync script only upserts what is here.
To add a week: append an entry with an ISO start time. Times are UTC, which
is what LeetCode posts contests in.
Re-running the sync is safe. `contests` has a unique index on
(starts_at, platform), so the same week can be re-ingested any number of
times without creating a second reminder.
